name: Tone Modifier Frequency Response
description: Validates MOD3 lowpass filter response using sweep stimulus and spectral metrics. Expects high-frequency attenuation when tone is engaged at 80%. GAP-16 feature adoption.

capability_requirements.notes: Tests tone modifier (MOD3) frequency response via FFT transfer function

lowpass_centroid.description: Lowpass should reduce spectral centroid below 5kHz

lowpass_flatness.description: Filtered signal should be less spectrally flat (shaped by lowpass)

use_cases: Validate MOD3 tone modifier frequency response
Test lowpass filter shape via FFT transfer function
Regression detection for filter algorithm changes
pass_criteria: Frequency response matches lowpass filter shape with high-frequency attenuation
example_failures: Flat response → Tone filter not engaged
High centroid → Filter not attenuating highs
